div.div: The same publish request may arrive twice (a retry, a double tap, two devices). The pair owner plus publishIntentId allows only one Reel; a fingerprint rejects a request that reuses the id with different content, and a race on the database unique rule is reconciled to the Reel that won (idempotency).
